effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can Special Summon 1 FIRE monster with an ATK of 1500 or less in face-up Attack Position from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the battle-destruction trigger resolves with no FIRE monster of 1500 or less ATK left in the Deck, the goat script proves the whiff by revealing the Deck (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. The printed text is behaviourally unchanged.

changes.historical_text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, you can Special Summon 1 FIRE monster with an ATK of 1500 or less in face-up Attack Position from your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Separate per-card ruling: the goat script's activation legality keeps only the free-zone test ('if chk==0 then return Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0 end'), dropping the modern additional requirement that a Special Summonable FIRE monster with 1500 or less ATK actually be in the Deck, so the trigger may be activated on a search that cannot find anything. Nothing in the packet dates when this card lost that allowance, so the chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Baseline implements lineage v1 (DB1-EN047, 2004-10-12, exact cdb match); v0 (MRL-081, 2002) precedes it and only sheds the redundant 'no Tribute is required for Level 5 or more' parenthetical and the select/shuffle procedure. Trailing v1 -> v5 (SGX1-ENH04) is cosmetic: 'sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle' -> 'destroyed by battle and sent to the GY', PSCT colon, 'face-up Attack Position' -> 'Attack Position'. The lineage is non-monotonic - v3 (SRL-081 in Legendary Collection, 2010-10-01) reprints the older v1 wording after v2 (RP01-EN069) - and the packet's Retro Pack NA date (2024-08-23) is anomalous against its EU date (2008-07-08); neither affects this record, since no change here is dated from a printing. Reveal and relaxed activation are recorded separately because only the reveal has sourced bounds; the intermediate state needs no implementation, as GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) both precede 2011-02-02.
